description: Boolean radio-button toggle (Yes / No) that conditionally reveals a content section when the value is true. Useful for form fields where selecting 'Yes' expands additional input fields. Labels are fully localizable and the component supports a null (unset) initial state.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Current toggle value. True = Yes selected, False = No selected, null = nothing selected.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects Yes or No.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Label rendered above the radio buttons and used as the radiogroup aria-label.

parameters.name: TrueLabel
parameters.description: Override text for the Yes option. Defaults to the localized 'Yes' string.

parameters.name: FalseLabel
parameters.description: Override text for the No option. Defaults to the localized 'No' string.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: When true, both radio buttons are disabled.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Content rendered in the expanded section below the toggle. Only visible when Value is true.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the root element.

examples.title: Basic Yes/No toggle without content
examples.code: <TmToggleSection Label="Do you have a VAT number?" @bind-Value="_hasVat" />

examples.title: Toggle with expandable child content
examples.code:
<TmToggleSection Label="Do you have a VAT number?" @bind-Value="_hasVat">
    <TmTextInput Label="VAT Number" @bind-Value="_vatNumber" />
</TmToggleSection>
